profile.headline: Software Engineer at Allstate/National General Insurance Company
profile.summary:
I discovered my love of coding in college, but what sparked my journey to a new career was the idea for an app that would be a bridge to help new listeners discover the joy of beautiful music.
     Creation is my passion, whether it is creating a beautiful chamber music performance or a bit of code to imagine and implement a new software solution.
     What joy to see projects come to life!

positions.title: Student at Tech Elevator
positions.description:
.Net bootcamp student at Tech Elevator. Below is a list of projects that I have completed during my time here.

Vending Machine Software:
-Developed a command line vending machine application using OOP fundamentals and FIle I/O
Online Payment Service Software:
-Developed a RESTful API server and command-line application for money transfer between users
Video Study Aid Software:
-Created a command-line study aid program to create time-stamped notes using OOP fundamentals and File I/O
